title: Ship an LLM Service Safely
intro: Your team is putting a self-hosted LLM chatbot into production. You take it from build to on-call: a multi-platform image, a supply chain you can prove, a GitOps deploy, the serving stack itself, the first production incident, and the SLO that tells you whether it's reliable enough.
resolution: You built one image for every architecture without leaking a secret into it; generated its SBOM, scanned it, signed it by digest, and verified the signature; deployed it through Git so every change is reviewed and a rollback is a revert; served the model with its memory budget explicit; debugged the crash-loop that a 'harmless' model swap caused; and defined the SLO that decides when reliability work beats new features. Each layer answered a different question: what's in it, is it the real thing, how did it get there, does it fit, and is it good enough.
